description: Data for: Repurposed Electric Vehicle Battery Performance in Second-life Electricity Grid Frequency Regulation Service is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Chris White. These files contain experimental results collected in 2018 during testing of six second-life electric vehicle batteries under a 24-hour frequency regulation (FR) duty-cycle prescribed by Sandia National Laboratories (SNL). The maximum FR power in the duty-cycle is four times the 4-hour constant-power discharge rate of the battery in question. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2020. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
